milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The dark_oak_button is placed at spawn-relative (7,1,1) on a wall facing west. The player must be within 16 blocks and facing toward it (60° tolerance). max_distance=16 is generous since the button is in the first room, but the facing requirement prevents false triggering at spawn (player spawns facing +Z, button is ~82° off that direction).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The red_glazed_terracotta cluster is at spawn-relative (9,0,3), (10,0,3), (9,0,4). Target set to (9,0,3). max_distance=10 ensures the player has navigated through the first doorway into room 2 rather than just looking from spawn (from spawn the facing angle is ~72° off default direction, exceeding tolerance).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The potted_red_tulip is at spawn-relative (12,1,9) on an oak_planks pedestal in room 3. max_distance=10 ensures the player has navigated through the second doorway at z=5 into room 3 and is facing the flower pot.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The pink_glazed_terracotta cluster is at spawn-relative (2,0,15), (3,0,15), (2,0,16) in room 4. Target set to (2,0,15). max_distance=10 ensures the player has navigated through the third doorway into the final room and is facing the terracotta blocks.
